name: Issue 1870: the Glyphic Frost Glyph passive grants Frost Glyph on Elemental Burst and Primordial Blast
contract: Issue 1870 names Frost Glyph 500309, 'Using Elemental Burst and Primordial Blast now grants you Frost Glyph.'
500309 is the PassiveSpell of ChrSpecs 62 (Glyphic, field 27), the spell the client's spec choice card shows
(CoASpecChoiceMixin: icon:SetSpell(specInfo.PassiveSpell)); no CharacterAdvancement entry, trainer or script
grants it. The spec's granted identity passive is ChrSpecs field 28, CharacterAdvancement 4061 = Frost Glyph
92152 (Rank 'Specialization', level 10, automatic), whose description is the same text. Frost Glyph 520090 reads
'Unleash: Deals Frost Damage and slows movement speed by $520110s1% (30%) for $520110d', unleashed by Glyphic
Ruin or Thaumaturgy. Expected: without 92152 Primordial Blast 800732 grants no Frost Glyph; with it, Primordial
Blast and Elemental Burst 502838 each grant 520090, and Thaumaturgy 804550 consumes it, dealing Unleashed Frost
Glyph 520096 damage and slowing the target with 520110.
